Presenting AE BAI TU KAHAAN SE AAYI FULL VIDEO SONG from GEHRI CHAAL movie starring Amitabh Bachchan, Hema Malini, Jeetendra, Madan Bindu in lead roles, released in 1973. The song is sung by Kishore Kumar and music is given by Laxmikant-Pyarelal, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: AE BAI TU KAHAAN SE AAYI
Singer: KISHORE KUMAR
Music Director: LAXMIKANT-PYARELAL
Lyricist: RAJENDRA KRISHAN
The only film to feature Amitabh Bachchan and Jeetendra together.
Enjoy and stay connected with us!!
